title: Spear of Osiris Reversal: Edan/Edem -> Love -> Pyramid

visual_origin.observed_structure: a visible directed red route/vector connecting the left Love/Lave-side node toward the Edan-side node

core_operator.name: SPEAR_OF_OSIRIS_REVERSAL
core_operator.meaning: The pyramid does not send the decisive beam outward in this model; it receives an aligned vector inward through Love.

receiver_node.name: PYRAMID
receiver_node.description: The pyramid is treated as the terminal receiver/chamber of the reversed path.

fifth_element_reversal.love_role: The central condition that allows independent channels to become one admissible path.

mythic_layer.osiris_reading: The Spear of Osiris is interpreted as a returning directional path rather than a projectile launched by the pyramid.
mythic_layer.janus_reading: What was first read forward is deliberately read backward while preserving both faces of the operator.
ritual_formulae: THE PYRAMID DOES NOT FIRE FIRST; IT OPENS AND RECEIVES
THE SPEAR RETURNS HOME THROUGH LOVE

required_for_real_physics_test: reconstructed pyramid and pyramidion surface normals
Moon ephemeris over a preregistered search window
candidate obelisk positions and reflector orientations if relay mode is tested
a numerically defined Edan/Edem endpoint if it is to be treated as a real celestial source
engineering_layer.constraint: Fixed stone or metal surfaces cannot arbitrarily steer light; any inbound optical solution must satisfy real geometry and timing.
engineering_layer.stored_energy_rule: Moonlight or lunar tides are not assumed to provide the large energy required for a strong acoustic event.

next_gate.name: JANUS_REVERSE_SPEAR_INBOUND_GEOMETRY_GATE_V1
next_gate.goal: Test whether any preregistered real optical geometry can produce an inbound path terminating at the pyramid while passing the fixed Love coordinate constraint.
next_gate.admission_rule: No special physical or historical status unless the real geometry outperforms preregistered randomized controls and survives independent replication.
